title: galium erectum var. rigidum
intro: Galium erectum var. rigidum, commonly known as stiff-leaved bedstraw, is a variant of the Galium erectum plant, a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, making it useful for wound healing and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of stiff-leaved bedstraw include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce pain and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
